method: Kotlin lexical literal scan; constructor inheritance, setting DSL, Tagged enums, tree/mode argument references; comments excluded
limitations: No Kotlin execution or compiler symbol/type resolution
Configuration-reference closure is file-level and can include unrelated declarations in a helper file
Dynamic constructor names, generated modes and callbacks require evaluated-runtime verification
Module-directory vocabulary includes unregistered modules and unattached helper/mode files; this is an upper bound
Coverage measures display vocabulary, never gameplay implementation or exact native config-tree parity
